root_resolution.note: The basmala in 00-surah-text.json is part of the analysis frame. It strengthens divine agency, watchfulness, and mercy readings but introduces no extra branch IDs into this passage inventory.

surface_mechanism: The basmala places the oath, creation, claimed power, unseen observation, and bestowed eyes under divine naming and mercy.
90:1-2 binds oath, bounded land, residence, and legal or sacral availability around this city.
90:3-4 joins parent, offspring, origination, visible humanity, and a condition of strenuous hardship.
90:5-7 repeats supposition and exhaustive negation: the speaker imagines that no individual can overpower him and that no individual has seen him.
90:6 makes utterance, destructive expenditure, wealth, and piled abundance a single boast-accounting complex.
90:8 answers the failed reckoning of visibility by pointing to divine making and the paired seeing eyes.
